name: Bone Crypt
desc: A royal crypt where dark damage is common. Some Dark resistance is recommended.

name: Silken Depths
desc: A venomous spider nest. Poison resistance greatly improves survival.

name: Rotting Vault
desc: A plague vault saturated with poison damage. Prepare Poison resistance.

name: Cultist Sanctum
desc: Forbidden rites fill this temple with heavy Dark damage.
